title: excoecaria marginata var. obovata
intro: Excoecaria marginata var. obovata, commonly known as the Yellow Oleander, is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include pain relief, anti-inflammatory effects, and antimicrobial activity, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in Excoecaria marginata var. obovata may also contribute to its potential antiviral and antioxidant activities.
